integrity_boundary.purpose: Independent test of whether the same genotype-derived prediction vector changes balanced accuracy when only AZM breakpoint semantics change.

model.training_rule: For each categorical mechanism pattern, compare Laplace-smoothed P(pattern|NS) with P(pattern|S) under equal class priors.
model.reason: Transparent reproducible classifier using only committed genotype-derived mechanism metadata; no MIC used as a feature.

conclusion: On 3,799 public overlapping isolates, the same out-of-fold genotype-derived prediction vector loses 6.05 percentage points of balanced accuracy when evaluation labels change from EUCAST to CLSI semantics. This independently demonstrates claim-level metric sensitivity to breakpoint semantics, but it is not a reproduction of the original 2019 Kover/RF model.
